business_constraints.del_required: 所有查询必须加 a.del = 0（强制逻辑删除过滤）

business_rules.name: 教研活动
business_rules.description: type=3 教研活动场景下，edu_campus_school_class_id 可为 NULL

business_rules.name: 科目名称展示
business_rules.description: 根据edu_course_exam_subject_name_id，通过关联 edu_course_exam_subject（三级）、edu_course_exam（二级）、edu_course（一级），按 '一级-二级-三级-四级' 的顺序拼接展示，例如使用 CONCAT(c1.name, '-', c2.name, '-', c3.name, '-', c4.name) AS full_subject_name

business_rules.name: 授课形式展示
business_rules.description:
CASE 
  WHEN es.english_teaching = 2 AND es.jingsai_teaching = 2 THEN CONCAT('英语授课，竞赛', CASE WHEN es.trial_teaching = 2 THEN '，试听课' ELSE '' END) 
  WHEN es.english_teaching = 2 AND es.jingsai_teaching = 1 THEN CONCAT('英语授课', CASE WHEN es.trial_teaching = 2 THEN '，试听课' ELSE '' END) 
  WHEN es.english_teaching = 1 AND es.jingsai_teaching = 2 THEN CONCAT('竞赛', CASE WHEN es.trial_teaching = 2 THEN '，试听课' ELSE '' END) 
  ELSE CASE WHEN es.trial_teaching = 2 THEN '试听课' ELSE '常规课' END 
END

business_rules.name: 调课状态派生
business_rules.description: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_adjust_study WHERE old_study_id = a.id AND del = 0 AND ((adjust_status = 3) OR (adjust_status = 1 AND valid = 1)))

common_sqls.title: 排课→校区/教室/分校（三层）
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN edu_campus_school_class b ON a.edu_campus_school_class_id = b.id
LEFT JOIN edu_campus_school c ON b.campus_school_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN edu_campus d ON c.campus_id = d.id

common_sqls.title: 排课→科目（四层）
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN edu_course_exam_subject_name e ON a.edu_course_exam_subject_name_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN edu_course_exam_subject f ON e.subject_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN edu_course_exam g ON f.exam_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN edu_course h ON g.course_id = h.id

common_sqls.title: 排课→学员（仅 type=1）
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN edu_study_student x ON x.edu_study_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN edu_student y ON x.edu_student_id = y.id AND y.del = 0 AND y.type = 1

common_sqls.title: 排课→老师/创建人
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN edu_teacher m ON a.edu_admin_user_id = m.admin_user_id
LEFT JOIN admin_user u ON a.admin_user_id = u.id

common_sqls.title: 排课→班课
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN edu_room_study r ON r.edu_study_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN edu_room r2 ON r.edu_room_id = r2.id

common_sqls.title: 排课→视频
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN edu_video v ON a.id = v.edu_study_id AND v.del = 0
LEFT JOIN edu_video_address va ON v.id = va.edu_video_id AND va.del = 0
